I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. It's a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant, so you can tune it. At 5 requests per second the minimum gap is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves some headroom. I didn't run the tests, because they hit the live sandbox.

The loop makes 4 calls, so the sleep adds about 1 second to the test. The sleep also runs after the last call, which is unnecessary but harmless.

I also saved the 5 req/s limit to EngramDB as a hazard note, so later sessions know about it.
